subject: paper01-original-lem-products-literal-source-back-and-forth
scope: Actual finite ordinary group terms in {+,-,0}, literal evaluation in actual additive commutative groups, exact atomic equality agreement; genuine ordinal well-founded recursion with α=0 atomic and α>0 every β<α and every finite RIGHT extension answered on LEFT with reversed comparison. Product target is the entire original lemma for paired finite tuples; generalized from countable abelian p-groups to all additive commutative groups. No comparison law, Scott transfer theorem or product-preservation field is assumed. This does not itself supply infinitary formula/Scott semantics.
